title: CatalogScenario
responsibility: Stores revision-bound scenario declarations in catalog_scenarios through a supplied persistence adapter.

inputs.name: CatalogScenario.id
inputs.description: Required persisted row key. The model accepts it as an opaque string and does not generate or validate an ID format.

inputs.name: CatalogScenario.scenarioId
inputs.description: Authored scenario identifier associated with this row. The model stores and forwards it as a string without resolving it against a registry.

inputs.name: CatalogScenario.commit
inputs.description: Git commit identifier associated with this scenario record. The model treats it as an opaque string and does not validate its SHA format.

inputs.name: CatalogScenario.title
inputs.description: Display title captured for the scenario at the recorded revision. The model forwards it without deriving a title.

inputs.name: CatalogScenario.data
inputs.description: RevisionRegistry scenario entry retained with this catalog row as JSON. The model passes it through without parsing or executing the payload.

outputs.name: CatalogScenario.find
outputs.description: The adapter result for the row key, or null when the adapter reports no matching row. The model does not validate or transform a returned row.

outputs.name: CatalogScenario.findBy
outputs.description: The array returned by the adapter for the supplied partial attribute filter. The model adds no sorting, pagination, or result validation.

outputs.name: CatalogScenario.create
outputs.description: The row returned by the adapter after receiving a shallow copy of the complete input. The model does not generate the id or validate the returned row.

outputs.name: CatalogScenario.update
outputs.description: The updated row returned by the adapter, or null when the adapter reports no row. The model forwards a shallow copy of the patch and does not validate the result.

outputs.name: CatalogScenario.delete
outputs.description: The boolean returned by the adapter for the requested deletion. The model does not reinterpret what true or false means.

errors.name: Persistence operation failure
errors.description: Synchronous adapter exceptions are thrown unchanged, and adapter promise rejections propagate with their original error. For findBy, create, and update, an enumerable own-property getter can also throw while the model shallow-copies its input.

inputs.name: CatalogScenario.find.adapter
inputs.description: Persistence adapter used for the catalog_scenarios table. The model neither constructs it nor owns its connection lifecycle.

inputs.name: CatalogScenario.find.id
inputs.description: Required persisted row key. The model accepts it as an opaque string and does not generate or validate an ID format.

outputs.name: CatalogScenario.find
outputs.description: The adapter result for the row key, or null when the adapter reports no matching row. The model does not validate or transform a returned row.

errors.name: Persistence operation failure
errors.description: Synchronous exceptions from adapter.find are thrown unchanged, and rejected return promises reject with their original error. The model does not catch or translate either failure.
